name: uptime-check
description: Endpoint availability checks with no dependencies and no authentication — HTTP(S) health probes with latency and status-code assertions, raw TCP port reachability, and TLS certificate inspection with expiry math. Runs fully local using only the Python standard library (urllib, socket, ssl).
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: uptime.http
tools.description: Perform an HTTP(S) request against a URL and report whether it is up. Measures latency, follows redirects, and checks the status code against 2xx (or an expected status). Connection and timeout errors are returned as ok:false with an error string, never raised.

url.description: Full URL to probe, e.g. https://example.com/health

expectStatus.description: Exact status code that counts as up (default: any 2xx)

header.description: Optional request headers as a flat key/value object

tools.name: uptime.tcp
tools.description: Check whether a raw TCP port is open and accepting connections, measuring connect latency. Refused/timed-out connections are returned as open:false with an error string, never raised.

host.description: Hostname or IP address to connect to

tools.name: uptime.tls_cert
tools.description: Inspect the TLS certificate served by a host: subject, issuer, validity window, and days until expiry. Handshake/connection errors are returned with an error string, never raised.

host.description: Hostname to open a TLS connection to (also used for SNI)
